edits.old_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth. On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch,
edits.new_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth; the ruling also decides whether the change takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review). On the ruling, or at that campaign's close where one is ruled, it lands at once on its own branch,

note: Binding-change paragraph: the decision ask's ruling now also decides whether the change takes a campaign, and landing waits for that campaign's close where one is ruled.
